title: Purge cached project access
responsibility: Removes recognized cache files belonging to a principal and optionally one project, including unusable entries.

inputs.name: projectionCachePurge.directory
inputs.description: The directory to scan for lookup and projection JSON cache files with 64-character hexadecimal names.

inputs.name: projectionCachePurge.principalId
inputs.description: The principal identity whose cache entries should be removed.

inputs.name: projectionCachePurge.projectId
inputs.description: Optional project identity. If omitted or empty, all matching-principal projects are selected; otherwise that project and the shared project-list entry are selected.

outputs.name: projectionCachePurge
outputs.description: A promise completing after matching files are removed. Recognized files with missing or unparseable identity are also removed, regardless of principal. A directory-listing failure is treated as no entries; unlink failures propagate.
